_notes: Sheet 187 of the tournament savegame (8x4), read card by card from the image on 2026-11-13. CardID = 18700 + idx; 401 = character card (sheet 4, 5x2, index 1). The deck object of the save holds 31 cards: the 30 of the deck plus the character card, which is why the catalog says card_count 31 and card_ids [401, 18729].

Restriction band (WYATT EARP, DOC HOLLIDAY or ANY), values, boosts, texts and copies (xN printed on each card) of the 12 titles were compared with the screenshots' transcription in unmatched-memory (data/heroes/wyatt-earp.json, _source: unverified): all 30 cards agree, no mismatch.

Hero card (read from the image): WYATT EARP, RANGED, START HEALTH 15, MOVE 2; special ability SHOWDOWN. Sidekick DOC HOLLIDAY, RANGED, START HEALTH 8 (one Doc Holliday). The save's inner bag holds Wyatt's miniature (an assetbundle, 'Wyatt Earp'), Doc's piece (a Custom_Token named 'Doc Holliday', like Daisy's and The Porter's) and the two health dials ('Hero Health', 'Sidekick Health'); no counter dial and no other token.
